verdict.rationale: Gaudi 3 is an AI accelerator, so CUDA or ROCm/HIP toolchain support is a fair question for it. The evidence shows only Intel's own Gaudi software stack: PyTorch, DeepSpeed, vLLM and SGLang via docs.habana.ai, plus tools for migrating GPU-based models. Porting tools and PyTorch integration are adjacent capabilities, not CUDA or ROCm/HIP documentation listing this part as a supported target, so they earn no credit.
